marketing.summary: This week has no free post slots, so there are no new posts: all of 19–30 October is already scheduled and only the 30 October post is still a draft. Instagram numbers are missing because the API access was blocked (code 200), so I can't judge the funnel from data. The last known snapshot (W43 brief) was 2 followers, 0 reach and 20 profile views. Google shows the first signs of life: 5 impressions and 2 clicks over 28 days at an average position of 15.8, but no query data yet. Google hasn't indexed the English page yet, and mobile LCP on the Hungarian page is 2.7s, slightly above the 2.5s target. The most useful things this week are fixing the Instagram connection, requesting indexing, and logging applications.
marketing.bottleneck_reason: The Instagram profile couldn't be read (API access blocked), funnel_weeks is empty, and Search Console has only 5 impressions with no queries. Without reach, link clicks and application counts, no stage can be named the bottleneck. To log: weekly Instagram reach, profile visits and bio link clicks (copy them by hand from the Instagram app's Insights if the API stays blocked), site visits, and the number of form submissions in marketing/funnel.yaml.
wins: Technical health is strong: Website 100, AI search 100, Instagram 98, Google Search 94, Speed 94 (up from 88 in the last brief).
Google has started showing the Hungarian page: 5 impressions and 2 clicks from Hungary in 28 days, average position 15.8 (previously 0).
Both language versions have complete structured data (FAQPage, JobPosting, Organization, WebSite), hreflang, and an Instagram sameAs link.
The content calendar is fully approved through 29 October, with only 30 October still a draft.
problems: The Instagram API returns 'access blocked (code 200)', so there are no follower, reach or post figures.
The English page (/en/) is 'Discovered – currently not indexed' and has never been crawled.
Mobile LCP is 2.7s on the Hungarian page (2.4s on the English one); the Hungarian one is above the 2.5s 'good' threshold.
No funnel data is logged, so we can't tell whether any applications came from Instagram or Google.
No Reels are planned or published, even though Reels are the main way to reach people who don't follow us.
The site has only 7 FAQ entries and no real applicant questions have been collected yet.
decisions: Reconnect Instagram API access (check that the token and permissions are valid and the app isn't restricted in Meta Business settings) so next week's report has real numbers.
In Search Console, run URL inspection → Request indexing for https://bloommodels.hu/en/.
Approve or edit the 30 October draft post (not-from-budapest).
Log last week's applications and bio-link clicks in marketing/funnel.yaml, even if the number is 0.
Decide whether you can film 1–2 short Reels a week (studio detail shots are enough, no faces needed), since the Reel test below depends on it.
Write down the real questions applicants ask in DMs and the form, so they can become FAQ entries.

experiments.title: Trial Reel hook test
experiments.hypothesis: A question hook ('Mennyit lehet valójában keresni? Őszintén.') earns more profile visits per reach than a myth hook ('Ezt mindenki hiszi…') when shown to non-followers as Trial Reels.
experiments.metric: Profile visits per reach, and shares per reach, per Reel (compare the two hook types across 2+ Reels each)
